deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: "Save Changes" writes the current BIOS settings to NVRAM from within the interactive setup screen; the agent cannot press that option or confirm the write over SSH.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator selects "Save Changes" in BIOS setup and confirms the change is saved and persists after reboot; agent cannot drive the setup UI.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies the manual NVRAM write but adds reboot persistence although the source only says the setting can be saved.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds a named reversible target, persistence method, OOB recovery and baseline restoration.
historical_reviews.round_02: No additional exact-code technical record found.

original_test_intent: Verify that the standalone BIOS Save Changes action commits one approved pending setting without requiring the combined Exit or Reset actions tested by adjacent cases.
original_method: Capture a named baseline, edit only that field, invoke Save Changes while remaining in the approved setup flow, verify the saved/current state by the platform-defined method, and restore the baseline if needed.
manual_activity: A human must create the pending edit, select the standalone Save Changes control and observe the resulting BIOS state. A firmware-variable API would bypass the control under test.
safety_requirements: Do not invent a setting or write an unreviewed value.
Avoid high-risk boot/storage/security/management fields unless separately approved.
Distinguish Save Changes from Save-and-Exit and Save-and-Reset behavior.
Stop on unintended NVRAM delta or management/boot risk.
agent_execution_scope: Collect identity and supporting health/configuration evidence.
Do not operate BIOS, issue a substitute variable write or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field/value, verification semantics and recovery.
Perform/capture the standalone Save Changes action and restoration.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects an SSH substitute, but persistence after reboot is extra coverage unless the owner selects it as the approved verification method.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the interactive standalone Save Changes control; do not replace it with a software write, Exit, Reset or reboot sequence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Generic Save Changes, no-script state and 5/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture baseline, pending edit, Save Changes invocation, immediate saved-state indicator/value and final restoration; add reboot persistence only as an approved project extension.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS Save & Exit page implementation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Save Changes semantics and owner setting definition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines observable state transitions without conflating adjacent exit/reset functions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; optional reboot evidence is explicitly separate.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Named field and platform save semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some firmware defers or confirms writes differently; evidence must reflect documented behavior.

project_override_considerations: The project selects the safe field and verification method. If it adds a reboot, that extension must be recorded and must not redefine the master standalone Save Changes intent.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, field/value, approval and recovery
Standalone Save Changes action and immediate saved-state evidence
Restored final state, health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Criteria consistently target saving a setting. The generic Procedure leaves the concrete field and verification method to the project.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standalone save intent is identifiable. Missing target or verification details are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with its manual UI boundary but separates its added reboot claim from mandatory coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safety/evidence improvements while keeping the standalone action distinct.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Clarifies project extension and no-substitution boundaries.

review_improvement: Prevents adjacent Save-and-Reset behavior from being silently folded into this shorter standalone control test and bounds the NVRAM write to one field.
independent_technical_reasoning: The exact BIOS control is the object under test and must be manually invoked/observed. Supporting readback does not automate that core action, so MANUAL ONLY remains correct.
no_automatic_retry: Do not invoke Save Changes again automatically after ambiguous state; preserve evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
